about: The export rules the Exports module applies. They changed three times in twelve months, so a change should mean editing a value here, not a new release. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd.

realisation.rule: FEMA (Export of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2015
FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026

counted_from_choices.bl_date: the shipped-on-board date on the bill of lading

amend_by: 30 November after the end of the financial year

icegate_pages.about: Where a shipping bill is looked up on ICEGATE, checked 27 Sep 2026. The public shipping bill enquiry needs no login but asks for a captcha typed by hand; the IGST refund status is only shown after logging in.

SB000.meaning: ICEGATE matched the shipping bill with your GSTR-1. The refund goes into a scroll and is paid through PFMS to your bank account.
SB000.todo: Nothing to fix on ICEGATE. If no money arrives within a month of the scroll, check that your bank account is validated on ICEGATE for refunds.

SB001.words: shipping bill details wrong in GSTR-1
SB001.meaning: The shipping bill number, date or port in GSTR-1 Table 6A does not match the shipping bill.
SB001.todo: Correct Table 6A through Table 9A. It costs nothing.

SB002.meaning: The shipping line or its agent has not filed the export general manifest for this shipment, so customs has no record that the goods left.
SB002.todo: Ask your forwarder or the shipping line to file (or correct) the EGM. The refund validates by itself once it is in.

SB003.meaning: The GSTIN on the shipping bill is not the GSTIN of the return that reported the invoice.
SB003.todo: If it is another registration of the same business, give customs an undertaking through the officer interface; if not, correct the return.

SB004.meaning: The invoice reached ICEGATE a second time after it had already been validated; the first record counts.
SB004.todo: Nothing, unless the first record was the wrong one.

SB005.meaning: The invoice number on the shipping bill and in GSTR-1 Table 6A are not the same, character for character.
SB005.todo: If Table 6A is wrong, amend it through Table 9A. If the shipping bill is wrong, the fix goes through the port: a letter, the Annexure A table and a ₹1,000 challan per shipping bill.

SB006.meaning: The goods left from an inland container depot and the export manifest at the gateway port has not been filed or linked.
SB006.todo: Ask the shipping line to file the gateway EGM at the port; the depot's shipping bill links to it.
